title: Scaffold uuencoding-multi crate (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, error.rs)
description:
Create the crate skeleton for the uuencoding-multi crate.

- New directory: uuencoding-multi/ in the MIME workspace root (add to workspace Cargo.toml members)
- Cargo.toml: name='uuencoding-multi', version='0.1.0', edition='2021', license='MIT OR Apache-2.0', rust-version='1.75'
- Dependencies: uuencoding (path dep on ../uuencoding), serde (optional, feature-gated)
- No mime-tree dependency (see workspace invariant: callers extract subject/body bytes themselves)
- src/error.rs: MultiUuError enum with variants:
    MissingParts { expected: u32, present: Vec<u32> }  -- gaps detected in part set
    EmptyCollection  -- reassemble called on zero-part collection
    DecodeError(uuencoding::UuError)  -- inner decode failure
    DuplicatePart { part_number: u32 }  -- two parts with same number added
  All variants: Debug, Display, std::error::Error. Non-exhaustive.
- src/lib.rs: crate-level doc explaining multi-part UUencoding history, the sequencing protocol, and what this crate does/does not do. Re-exports: MultiUuError, PartEntry, PartCollection, TocEntry, SubjectParts, parse_subject, reassemble
- Quality gate must pass: cargo fmt, cargo clippy -p uuencoding-multi -- -D warnings, cargo test -p uuencoding-multi
